text:
support-ops: FYI customer HealthNet dropped a compliance packet into the intake queue. they want a formal response for HIPAA + SOC2 scoping, plus specific retention requirements (logs + audit trails for 7 years). due date: next Fri. can product/security triage?

anna.p: thanks — tagging eng + security. what's the ask breakdown? quick wins vs platform changes? :eyes:

samir: high-level: SOC2 attestation details + control mappings we already have should cover most SOC2 Qs. HIPAA asks are the tricky ones: data segregation, BAAs, granular audit logs, and retention 7y is longer than our default 1y logs. we need to decide hosted vs private commitments.

eli: paste from the packet (snip):
```
Q14: Describe data retention policy for audit logs and how customers can request deletion of PHI.
Q21: Evidence of encryption-at-rest key management and KMS rotation.
Q30: Do you retain IP addresses or request metadata beyond X days?
```

anna.p: ok. proposed triage: 1) quick response doc for HealthNet by EOD Tue with what we currently cover + known gaps. 2) create backlog epic for gap work (retention config, exportable evidence, BAA language). 3) propose timeline and acceptance criteria. sound reasonable? :+1:

marcus: from runtime side — retention >1y means cold storage export and long-term index. it's non-trivial: we need schema for archived KV cache + new purge policy flag. rough estimate: spec + infra changes ~2 sprints, infra work + testing ~3 sprints. also cost delta for customers — need pricing note.

natalie: product note — this feels like a customer-driven feature (P1 for sales), but platform-impacting. we should scope an MVP: a) configurable audit-log retention per-tenant up to 7y b) exportable attestation bundle (signed timestamps) c) doc updates + BAA template. Acceptance criteria idea: customer can set retention policy in console/API and download a signed audit package for any 90-day range.

samir: security asks: we can re-use existing KMS integrations for encryption-at-rest; need to provide key rotation evidence and config screenshots for hosted. For private, confirm they manage their own KMS. Also need to capture which logs contain PHI and add redaction guidelines.

anna.p: action items:
- support-ops to send HealthNet a short acknowledgement and estimated timeline (EOD Tue) — eli, can you?
- create GH epic `cust/healthnet-compliance` with labels `customer-request, compliance, hipaa, soc2` — i'll make it now.
- eng-runtime to triage technical scope and attach rough estimates — marcus will do.
- eng-security to prepare SOC2 control mapping doc + BAA draft — samir/natalie pair.

eli: sending ack now. message: "Thanks — we've received your packet and are triaging. We'll deliver an initial scope + timeline by Tue EOD. Assigned: Product (Anna), Security (Samir), Runtime (Marcus)." :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Automated reminder: attach SOC2 control mapping template to the GH epic or the ticket will be flagged as missing docs after 48h.

marcus: putting a short spec note in the epic: `retention_mode: [default(1y), extended(7y)], storage_tier: [hot, cold], purge_flag: boolean, export_api: /v1/audit/export`

anna.p: also calling out rollout constraints: hosted customers - we can offer extended retention on dedicated/reserved plans only (cost + infra). private deployments: require customer to confirm KMS config and archival storage. include this in the EOD ack.

samir: risks to surface to HealthNet: increased attack surface with long-lived logs, legal retention tradeoffs, and cost. propose a mitigation: role-based access to exported bundles + signed access logs.

natalie: product acceptance checklist (draft):
- config UI + API to set retention (per-tenant)
- background job to move to cold storage after X days
- export API with signed manifest and checksums
- docs + BAA + screenshot evidence pack
- test plan + perf/regression runbook

anna.p: timeline proposal to HealthNet in ack: initial scope by Tue, spec & acceptance criteria by end of week, implementation estimate within 2 weeks. prioritized as P1 for this account but P2 platform-wide.

eli: HealthNet replied: "Appreciate the quick ack. We can be flexible on timeline but need legal confirmation re: 7y retention. Please include cost estimate."

anna.p: noted. next steps: i'll post the GH epic link here once created and assign owners. tagging @samir @marcus @eli for follow-ups. :rocket:
